slots.name: pay.asks
slots.means: Before the money step: what the service asks at booking (a card line).

slots.name: pay.price

slots.example: Paid with 1 credit from your pack
slots.source: master-A.json and master-B.json record.slots.pay.price (home S13-55); audience: the master sends it to cust

slots.name: pay.took

slots.source: master-A.json and master-B.json record.slots.pay.took (home S13-55); audience: the master sends it to cust and owner

slots.name: pay.left

slots.source: master-A.json and master-B.json record.slots.pay.left (home S13-55); audience: its means line (reminders), no master message uses it yet

slots.name: pay.late

slots.source: master-A.json and master-B.json record.slots.pay.late (home S13-55); audience: the master sends it to cust

slots.name: pay.after

slots.source: master-A.json and master-B.json record.slots.pay.after (home S13-55); audience: the master sends it to cust

slots.name: pay.staff
slots.means: The money line on a pro's job page or an owner's message.
slots.reads: record.slots pay.staff rows, the first whose when fits
slots.example: Paid with 1 credit · nothing to collect
slots.source: master-A.json and master-B.json record.slots.pay.staff (home S13-55); audience: the master sends it to staff and owner

slots.name: pay.failed
slots.means: The failed-charge line, by who is on the page.

slots.source: master-A.json and master-B.json record.slots.pay.failed (home S13-55); audience: the master sends it to cust

slots.name: clock.pay

slots.name: two.count
slots.means: The $2 line: the $2 counts at the visit's first check-in code, or when the visit is marked DONE if no code was entered; no visit, no $2; one $2 per booking.

slots.example: No Rosie $2: Lee's Barbershop added this booking itself
slots.source: master-A.json and master-B.json record.slots.two.count (home A9-21; D86, D97); audience: the master sends it to owner

slots.name: reach.way

slots.name: reach.to

slots.name: who.ok

slots.example: Lee's Barbershop booked this for you.

slots.name: name.staff

slots.name: svc.intext

slots.source: SPEC-master 5h; overlay-core.js SLOTS line 1288; RULES 4.6; S13-22; audience: the master sends it to cust, owner and staff

slots.name: arrive
slots.means: When the pro arrives: {{arrive:8–10am}} reads 'arriving 8–10am', or 'starts at 8:00am' for a business whose sign-up setting is a set start (D48); on a sent-now booking 'arriving in about 60 to 90 minutes'.

slots.name: window

slots.source: SPEC-master 5h; overlay-core.js SLOTS line 1290; audience: the master sends it to cust, owner and staff

slots.name: cutoff

slots.name: day

slots.source: SPEC-master 5h (tools F); overlay-core.js SLOTS line 1293; audience: the master sends it to cust, owner and staff

slots.source: SPEC-master 5h; overlay-core.js SLOTS line 1294; audience: words of no one's booking, so every reader; no master message uses it
